text: Great place!  Popped over and sat outside for a great meal. Ribs, corn, fried green tomato sandwich were all awesome. Open until the weather gets too cold.

I don't know why it's taken me so long to leave a review for this humble and unassuming establishment.  I've been bringing friends and family here for delicious breakfast for years (more so when we lived near Westchase area).  Their food has consistently been great every time we've gone, the service is always friendly and prompt, and portions are generous!  Plus, the price really can't be beat.  

P.S. Do NOT pass up on their biscuits and gravy, better yet, get the biscuit debris...its DELICIOUS and your tummy will thank you for it :)

We got the same stuff as we often get. Fried calamari and the Uncle Frank. It got here roughly an hour or so after I ordered. Yes: it's football Sunday. So I should have a little patience, and I don't need a lecture.

So when I opened the calamari, I was totally annoyed at the chintzy amount of squid in the damn container. When I order fried calamari, I expect a good bit more than six ounces of it. It certainly tasted good, but two things impeded both it and the pizza.

Those two things were 1) the food was lukewarm; 2) the food was chintzy! I already explained how cheap they were with the amount of squid. It ran more or less the same with Uncle Frank. It was just lukewarm, and they were super chintzy with the sausage! 

One of the features of this thing is supposed to be sausage. It was more an afterthought than a feature. Quite honestly, these people appear to be getting cheap and cutting corners. Food still tasted good as usual, which is why I still give two stars. 

Football Sunday or not, COVID 19 or not, full moon, Neap tide or anything else or not...I can only tell you that I was disappointed, which is a polite way to say that tonight they truly sucked. If this is the way they're heading, then I'm heading back to Westshore. At least THEY seem to appreciate my business. These guys certainly appear not to do so. I'd almost lay money down to say they don't contact me or try to make it right. Calling would simply waste my time as well as theirs. Bah!!

This place is by far one of the best Mexican restaurants in the city I've been to. Per the review before mine, it is Americanized Mexican, but I can promise you you're not going to find real Mexican food anywhere in NOLA. 

I got the chicken enchilada and chicken taco a la charge, plus their pico and queso fresco. The chicken seemed to be higher quality grilled chicken rather than just cheap shredded chicken. The queso was pretty tasty and so was the pico! Not puréed salsa but rather the whole pieces of tomato, yum. 

I will definitely be back!

Why why why have I not tried this place sooner???? They have a cute patio set up in the back of the restaurant.  It is small so make reservations.  The food was great but the service was better. Everyone had a personality and made the meal more enjoyable. Since it was our first time we ordered a little of everything.  We started with Calamari and the Antipasto Romantico. Calamari was tender rings with fried battered pepper,  onions, and tomatoes sprinkled in. The Antipasto was soooo good. Ripe melon, meats, peppers and cheese. Next course was either a soup or salad with our entrees.  We got one of each. The only soup they have is this crepe and parmesan cheese soup. Very simple but delicious.  I like the fact they make their own Ceasar dressing.  Entrees we did a Branzino special and Zuppa de Pesce. Bronzino was very good in this white wine caper sauce. My dinner was the Zuppa de Pesce and probably weighed 6lbs. So much food. I got it in a fra diavlo sauce. Perfect. Both seafood entrees were cooked perfectly. To end this awesome meal we chose 2 desserts. Kahlua brownie pudding and Chocolate mousse cake.  Both great choices. Everything is made in house. The bread, pasta, and desserts. Definitely coming back.

I use to like this bar but it has changed mangers and staff so many times there must be a problem. New cooks also. I have gotten sick the last 3 times I ate at this place- Save your money and eat at a place that won't make you sick.

I came for a quick lunch this past Tuesday. I saw online that they had a good lunch special for the price. 2 rolls plus miso and salad for 8.95.. I sat at the bar. The place isn't as clean as I would expect, the guys behind the bar making the sushi were not friendly at all. The service was good and fast but same thing she was not friendly or pleasant. The ginger dressing on the salad was really good but the lettuce itself was not fresh almost wilted. I ordered a philly roll and a spicy crunchy crab roll. The spicy crab roll was great no complaints at all. But the philly roll was definitely under par. The salmon was not fresh and they put way too much cream cheese in the roll. I don't think I'll be coming back based on my lunch experience. The place was also dead and it was around 1:30 pm.

Have had both in restaurant and delivery meals and both were delicious. The last time I ordered pork spicy tonkatsu ramen for delivery. The soup arrived hot and was packaged well. I would like to see larger plastic spoons, but other than that, it was good and had just the right amount of spice. 

I've also eaten gyoza there and the sauce is well made - just enough tang to make the dumpling flavorful. Would definitely recommend both.

Cute little spot in francisville for delicious crepes! just a note though, there are some photos on this yelp page from a previous menu - they do not serve any eggs anymore. I love the nutella crepe, the philly crepe, and I've also had a few sandwiches that were good as well. 

My favorite drink here is an iced mochaccino- it will keep you up to get work done. I wish they had oat milk as a non-dairy option though. 

Pre-covid they were also pet friendly in the upstairs portion!

My husband and I had an amazing dinner. We shared a 22 oz aged ribeye steak, lobster mash and asparagus. It was amazing. I'm glad we did not start with an appetizer and salad because there's no way we would have enjoyed our meal. We would have been too full. Didn't have room for dessert so we ordered coffee which may as well be dessert. It came with some yummy fixings. GREAT service too. We had Bill and Lexi who were great!!! Definitely must come back.
This store has obviously undergone a change in management, and it's been for the best. The staff is friendly, I was greeted as soon as I walked in the door.

Came here for a date night with my hubby on a Friday night around 6. It was pretty busy already, which was expected. We grabbed drinks at the bar while we waited. We were told it would be a 30 min wait-we only waited maybe 15 mins before a table was ready for us. I ordered the Pizza Burger and my hubby had the Napoleon Burger-both were amazing! Messy...but absolutely delicious!! Drinks were good, service was great, food was amazing. 

My only critique is that the place is a little on the small side. It was a little awkward to be able to stretch my arm out and touch the customer at the table next to me. Okay, I didn't actually do that, but I could have! We could hear the other table's conversations they were so close.

Wanted to celebrate our Anniversary with a dinner out, but Covid changed our plans slightly, but it turned out to be one of the best dinners ever!
Ordered from Luisa's for the first time ever dining there and it was a wonderful experience. When I first called to place my order, they asked what time I would be picking up as they only allow one person in at a time. And they completely disinfect everything after each guest leaves (door handles, debit machine, counters, etc). After placing my order, he described the process of entering the restaurant, where to park at the back and the cleaning process, which I appreciated greatly. 

For our evening out, I ordered a side cesar salad, bread basket, lasagne and the chicken parmesan that they had for the special that evening. 
We took our meals to Lion's Park and had a lovely picnic instead of bringing the meals home. 

Our salad was a perfect sharing size and tasted great. The bread for the bread basket was a bit dry, but would have been perfect for bruschetta. So we'll make french toast with it at home. :) 

My spouse's lasagne must have weighed 5 pounds! The portion was huge and really delicious! The perfect combination of meat, pasta, sauce and cheese! 
I had the chicken parmesan special, which was a huge chicken breast marinaded over night, topped with italian meats (I don't remember exactly which ones...sorry...), sauce and cheese. It came with a large serving of pasta that had been tossed in butter, garlic and parmesan. I coul

This is my new favorite pho spot.  Delicious.  Friendly.  Cost is great and it's close.  

Good pho is hard to find here but this place knocks it out of the park.
You have to know this place is here. Super cool space. Quality fresh bread and inventive ingredients make for delicious sandwiches. If I lived in Nashville I would be a regular.

I have been multiple times now. I so very want to love this place, but its eh. Then when you add the bad service it makes is very underwhelming. I went with a client and after long waits, we would have to ask again for items such as OJ etc. Got a latte made incorrectly and instead of rushing to make a new one, the drink was still charged to the bill. All these things add up to a not so great experience. This is the 4th time, I have been here and hope that each trip will be better, but the service continues to go downhill. Breakfast shouldn't cost $66 after gratuity for 2 people when service isn't spectacular and food spot on. Now my food was okay, it was fine. Not amazing, but it was not bad and presentation was nice. I love coffee and love their choices, but if it takes too long to get and its not properly made it just makes for a bad experience.

This was my second experience here and I can recommend the food, but not the service. All 3 stars are for the food and beer options.

You should know that I'm that guy that thinks tipping 15% is an insult to the level of service. I totally understand how difficult it is to serve me and the other million idiots out there.

If a waiter sucks but is personable you get forgiven, if your personality sucks but you do an efficient job you're forgiven but if you have neither.. Well we have a problem.

I have no idea who's in charge of this restaurants front of house but they need to re-evaluate their training practices.

Specifics? The first visit we were the only guests and had a great time. Tonight, I waited 20 minutes for a beer. Apparently they had to change the keg. Rather than just tell me that I was left to wonder. 

I had to ask to order twice.. The server barely acknowledged our existence and would frequently disappear in the back. BTW there were two servers and maybe 20 people in the restaurant.

For a $200.00 mean the service sucked. For a fast food restaurant the service was acceptable.

The food was really good as the kitchen was well staffed and the chef obviously put a lot of thought into the menu. Please bring back the zucchini cakes.

I'll go back one more time and if the staffing issues are still the same that will be it.

Just tried Marlene's Original Breakfast Sandwich for the first time and WOW!!! What an excellent breakfast sandwich!!!! I had the #8 and my wife had the #1 and both sandwiches were EXCELLENT!!!! Very filling and packed full of flavor!!!! Definitely coming back to try some more sandwiches!!!
We ordered the rotisserie chicken and fried flounder. Both were very good. Chicken was seasoned well and juicy and the fish was crispy and really good. Sides were delicious as well.

We've been going to Los Patios since they opened (the one on Kentucky Ave) and the food was really delicious with large portions. We went there today (May 5th) for carry out and were very disappointed, no social distancing and the portions were half the size they used to be. We were just trying to support one of our local mom and pop restaurants but feel that they were taking advantage of their patrons. Needless to say we'll never go back!

Service was very fast and seamless. Pizza was slightly better than a frozen pizza from the store. While the crust was good, the cheese was not stringy and melty at all. Garlic knot was kind of flavorless and dry. If you order a whole pizza it might be fresh and stringy, but if you're just getting a slice on a lunch rush it's a gamble whether or not you'll like it.

I've been wanting these nachos for YEARS. And I'm so glad I finally made my way to Kenner. I ordered the Messy combo, and my bf ordered the coward nachos with chili. The nachos and messy tea was delicious! Great service as well. Would definitely come again!

Go to this place! It's a tiny spot and if you blink, you'll miss it but it's totally worth the stop. I had the pastor tacos and they're not the usual bright pink ones, but omg are they amazing! Very well seasoned and tender pork. I also ordered a cheese popusa and let me tell you, this was the best popusa I've ever had. I've had them from so many different places in Los Angeles, but this place has them beat. They stuff them with beans and chicharron also, but I just went with cheese. They do vinegar slaw and tomato sauce to pour over the top. Delicious!

A rare 5-star rating from me. As far as pizza goes in Indianapolis, there is Jockamo, there is Bazbeaux, and then there's everyone else (although Some Guys Pizza is really good too).

I have been to the original store in Irvington many times but have never reviewed it, so I'll probably do that sometime. But it would be very similar to this one. 

The Fort Harrison location is good because it's usually far less crowded, and it has much more parking. The service there  has always been very good. The craft beer selection is good. 

But it's the pizza. It's all about the pizza. I've had the Slaughterhouse Five and the Cheese Louise. They're outstanding. I've had the Lasagna Pizza, which is also very good. Yesterday I had a half Lazyboy (which is a supreme) and half Philly Jack (which is basically a cheesesteak pizza with peppers and stuff on it). It was superb, especially the Philly Jack part. Super fresh ingredients, a fair amount of cheese, a crust that's crispy without being hard or crumbly, and sauce that has a strong and wonderful taste from its spices.

This location also has a patio, so that's a nice addition when the weather is nice, and I believe it's fine if you bring your dog. 

I'm almost always going to favor a locally owned, mom and pop restaurant over a chain. I do like Jet's Pizza and order from there occasionally because there's a store across the street from where I live. But if it was my choice, I'd go to Jockamo every time. One day I'll figure out how to pass

I've been eating to come here for a long time. Today my daughter and me stopped after my dialysis treatment. The food was terrific!!! I had an Western Omlet with home fries and toast. My daughter had Crepes and eggs. The food was delicious!!!! So much food I had to bring it home. The coffee was great. I've. Had coffee at some other local places and it always tastes burnt. The waitress was so nice and helpful. As soon as we walked in she was at our table for our order. The food arrived fast. I will be back here again for sure. My friends at dialysis are waiting to here how it was, so they will try it!!! If you are in the area don't hesitate to try it.

We have dined at Noble Crust since their opening in St. Pete. Have had family gatherings and taken advantage of their take out also. Our experiences have varied but for the most part more good than bad. Their bucatini and short ribs with burrata is a sure thing as is their fried chicken platter.  Our most recent experience was Saturday eve. They were nice enough to take our party of 4 with a reservation. Seated immediately but THE AIR CONDITIONING WAS RIDICULOUS. PREVIOUSLY, inside we had issues with the blasting A/C on us and the table. We sat up against the wall (luck of the Irish) our poor guests were not so fortunate. They were freezing. Uncomfortably cold. Inside, we have been in similar situations and when we left it wasn't about the food but about the blowing air. So, why write a review about a restaurants HVAC? Because it affected our overall dining experience.

Go for the blueberry, a deliciously moist cake donut, or one of their AMAZING cinnamon rolls, which is slightly crisp and fried like an old fashioned donut. Small, but delicious selection and wonderfully friendly service!
Another amazing dinner last night. Amazing food. Amazing service. Three new menu items. Try the duck and the broccoli slaw.

This place was packed and has a really fun vibe! I enjoyed grouper cheeks and husband had tacos. 

If looking for unhealthy pub food this is the place to go! Definitely be fun place to meet up with friends. I would go again! Staff was excellent- you didn't just have one waitress everyone was always checking up on us. 

Good food, good time --- check it out :)

Such a beautiful bookstore with an adorable coffee/tea shop. The couches and extra tables on the upper floor make for the perfect place for a quick coffee or to get some work done. There's a restaurant and champagne bar inside as well, so there's no excuse to miss happy hour. We'll definitely be back to this gem!
Good food when they have it.  Just left there and now for the 3rd time in a row, they were out of ribs. How can a BBQ place be out of ribs? We will find another Rib place...
Very good Mexican food!!! The Grande Burrito is excellent and plentiful. If you are still hungry after this burrito I don't know what to say....Service was also very good. Highly recommended!!

My boyfriend and I went there for our anniversary dinner and had a great experience! We started our dinner with the charcuterie board which was very delicious and surprisingly filling, it was such a big portion that we couldn't even finish the whole thing, which is a great problem to have. For our entrees my boyfriend ordered the 10oz filet with the lobster Mac and cheese, and I ordered the 16oz ribeye and the twice baked potato, we also both added a side of the bourbon peppercorn sauce. Both steaks were cooked to perfection and the sides were delicious! However I would skip the sauce next time as it was a little too salty. We ended our dinner with the bourbon bread pudding which was outstanding! Overall we enjoyed our experience here, oh and can't forget to mention that our server was super knowledgeable and did a great job!

I called for delivery and was put on hold for six minutes until I hung up and called back. My order was delivered wrong. I called to tell them about it and they could care less. Not even an apology. The girl said, "Well I didn't take your order I was across the street getting change." I asked for the manager and they said he was "busy" and the phone girl literally repeated everything I was saying to him. He didn't sound busy. 

On to the food.
- fries are soggy and gross. I asked what kind of fries they have while I was ordering. She said steak fries. These look like potato wedges to me? 
-mozzy sticks came clumped together in a ball. Very greasy. 
-I ordered two pizza rolls. They sent two pizza rolls that are really pepperoni rolls (undercooked also) and two steak rolls. Who ordered steak rolls? Not me! Since when is there pepperoni in a pizza roll? 
-I ordered a cheeseburger platter with American cheese and asked for wiz on the side for my fries. I got a plain burger with no cheese. Also no coleslaw like the menu states. 
-chicken parmesan sandwich and wings were good. 

I paid $70 for this meal and I'm very disappointed.

Pretty decent burger spot in Nashville with nice service; we came on a Friday night and had to wait quite a bit of time to be seated even though our name was on the waitlist. Overall, we enjoyed our food (I had the lamb burger and my boyfriend had one of the beef burgers with jalapeños,) but I don't think I would go out of my way to eat here again. Street parking was pretty easy at night, but I could see how it could possibly be a hassle during busy hours.
My first time at Deez Greek Cafe, and they did not disappoint! Great food made with love, and now one of my favorites!

We had an amazing meal at Jonathans last night. The food was spot on and we didn't have to wait long at all. The steak was cooked perfectly and the fries were hot and fresh. We wanted something local and off the beaten path and are so happy that we found this place. The lighting was dim and it was very loud in the restaurant but  we didn't feel like we were yelling at each other and it was an intimate feel. I highly recommend dining here!

Ok I know I have been here back in the days. Tiny casino. Locals style. Baldini's. Well we came here for the restaurant with the $11.99 prime rib special. This place is smoky and dank with motorcycles about and a lot of blue collar regulars. Lucky the eats is to the right just inside the door

Our waitress was super nice. Unfortunately, they were out of prime rib at 8pm. I settled on the rib eye steak 12 oz. For $14.95. My dad got the NY steak 8 oz. For $8.95 and my mom got the senior fish and chips $5.95. The steaks came with green beans and choice of potato. I got the baked potato and it was the smallest one ever! Green beans were decent. Steak was good but not amazing. 

Prices here are local cheap. That is the best part. The menu is vast with American favorites. I would recommend this place if you want to eat on a budget that day and get some good 'ole American fare with excellent servers.

Came here in February 2019. Was still on my antibiotics for pneumonia and was running around doing errands that morning when my medication alarm when off and I was not suppose to take the medication on an empty stomach - seeing Einstein down the street, I parked and walked in.

The place is clean. The staff was super friendly (and I believe this was a very early Saturday Morning). I ordered a toast Jalapeno Bagel (no cream tea) with Chia Tea, both where tasty. 

It's a Bagel shop - not fine dining. As long as the staff are friendly and the place is clean, I'm happy.

I had such an incredible time celebrating Persian new year! This was my first time having Persian food and my experience was simply amazing! The service was great and the food was incredible! I will definitely be coming back for more!

The one that started it all.  I always knew that Hooters started in Clearwater  - I just assumed it started on the beach. But, instead, it started here- about halfway between the Bay and the Gulf.  

It seems like a normal Hooters.  Good wings, okay service- tacky, but refined - right? 

If you are a big fan of Hooters then you need to include this restaurant and bar on your tour of Tampa Bay, but if you aren't, then don't.  There isn't anything special or unique about it- except that it all began here.

My fiancé and I have had great experiences here and the happy hour deals are great when we're lucky enough to make it in time. Today was a little off in that I picked up a to-go order, one of many we've had with usually good luck, but this was too funny not to share. Maybe it was unintentional but we looked closely at the container and lid for signs of movement but there are no oil or water residue marks - it seems like somebody got "creative" with the placement of my nigiri order. Not a big deal, but hopefully next time all comes out right side up
OMG. I still have not gotten tired of Chipolte.  I use the app and order 15 minutes before,  and it is ready when I arrive. I'm in trouble.

HORRIBLE HORRIBLE SERVICE!!!!!! Never again We went last night with my two friends , waited 10 plus mins to even be acknowledged, had to ask for refills, had to ask for everything. 2 servers 11 tables. Many people you could tell were upset one table had to stop her to take his CC and then it took 30 mins to return it to him. Others didn't even get silverware. My gf ordered 2 rolls, other friend steak hibachi , myself sushi combo $18.99 my gf got her two rolls and my roll and 20 mins later the other friend received her hibachi after I had to ask where our soup and salad was which she brought mine but, AGAIN i had to ask for hers and her water w/lemon. My other friend asked for refills and yum yum sauce I had to go get it and the little plates that hold soy sauce. I asked why my roll was on her plate they didn't know and then i asked where the rest of my food was again NO IDEA and then brought the wrong food 15 mins later when i explained it was wrong they had me point to the menu I did and again wrong then i had to point to it to another server ( yes they understood me and spoke perfect english) They gave up and took it back didn't even try to help , I was nice up until then because i think they were short staffed but dang really?? I finally had it and told them we are done, we were ignored for another 20 mins , finally the check came , we took it up because it would of been another 30 mins and already been there over 2 hrs. I told the hostess and asked for a manger none there

I've always liked Beck's a lot. I hadn't been here for several years. But today I decided to give them a shot. 

Now, at the risk of coming off as a complete snob here, I was a little let down today. Since the last time I had Beck's I've been to New Orleans. I've tasted the real deal. They're playing on a different culinary level down there. 

I now know why Beck's is considered really good for Philadelphia. But in New Orleans I sense they wouldn't quite cut it. And maybe that's not a fair comparison. But I believe it's true now. 

I went with a catfish finger platter with red beans and rice. My biggest complaint was the catfish. They came off a little chewy and overdone. The seasoning was way more salty than anything. Not bad, but far from great. 

I will say that the beans and rice were tremendous. That flavor was on point with more spice than salt. And I still like the cornbread. 

It's quite possible I just didn't get their best dish. I still have love for them. But I'm calling this one as I see it, or in this case taste it.

It's okay for a quick take away or dine in. But not a great Chinese place.. they have a lot of options but the taste is average and can be better. I haven't tried a lot of their items, but from what I have tried, the food is above or close to average. The Beijing beef and egg drop soup are a good try!

We came to this restaurant on the recommendation of our hotel.  The ambiance, food and drinks were wonderful.  The reason for the 3 stars is due to the wait staff not wearing masks properly.  Our waitress while very friendly and attentive, did not cover her mouth and nose with a mask even though she had one.  It made it difficult to feel comfortable while engaging with her and we had to resort to wearing our masks while interacting with her.  Additionally other staff had their masks on under their noses or down on their chins.

This was a very tasty meal.  I had the gnocchi and got the Creme Brûlée for dessert.  The Creme Brûlée made me sit back in my seat and stop talking, it was absolutely delicious!  The service was good, not great.

I gotta say I was immensely impressed by this restaurant. From the unassuming entrance on south street to the ambiance to the chefs counter it was a really really great experience. The food is by far on of the top five meals I have ever had in philly and the deep fried duck breast sandwich is probably the best thing I have ever ate in my life. Service was impeccable as well. However it all came crashing down at the bill. I had two whiskey pours that night, both reasonably priced (or so I thought) until I got the bill. When I order my whiskey I usually ask for a little ice on the side because most places don't have big cubes. The waiter asked if I would like one big cube with my whiskey instead of the cup of ice. I said sure, since it is my preferred way to drink whiskey. When I got the bill I found out they charged me an extra $2.50 PER DRINK for each big cube!!! It came up as a "king cube" on the receipt. You have to be kidding me. This wasn't craft ice or some crazy shaped ice but the same exact big cubes you can make at home with a tray from amazon. 2.50 for ICE. I understand it's a small charge compared to the price of the meal but it's the principal of it. I HAVE NEVER BEEN CHARGED FOR ICE EVER WHEN DRINKING WHISKEY UNTIL NOW. I thought about this for a few days before deciding to write my review. The attention is in the details with fine dining restaurants and they blew it at the finish line with a petty/greedy charge for ice! I may be back but the ice charge will be th

I'm here for a long Hallo-weekend to celebrate my birthday! This was our first stop because of it's proximity to our housing and we are definitely very happy!! 
I got the hot chicken sandwich, which was delicious, crispy and juicy. I got a side of mac which was also very good. 
The blackberry sour on draft is also very good- I highly recommend. 
Also, the service is phenomenal- which I guess I should've expected because Nashville is known for friendliness!! 
This spot is definitely a must-visit on your trip if you are out of town. I wish I had one back in Bmore!

If there's one thing you can count on in the French quarter, it is that you will encounter a great deal of misinformation about which restaurants are good. These businesses have rent to pay and cut a lot of corners. You could end up with frozen French fries or stale bread in a place with a white tablecloth quick. Be careful.

That being said, Cafe Amelie is one of the good ones. Pleasant dining in the garden out front, creative yet inviting menu options, servers who are articulate and understand the menu and who are able to make good recommendations. Fair prices and food that is a cut above average in the area. 

We had a breakfast croissant, a shortrib dish, and the chicken and waffles. Couldn't pick a favorite. Would order any of the 3 again. The shortrib was seasoned just right and came apart without the aid of a knife. The chicken was juicy and fell right off the bone, and the sausage gravy on it made for a really hearty dish. Loved it.

To sum it up you can count on a good meal here, and you can expect to eat it in a clean and pleasant space. I'm putting this down as one of my favorite spots in this area.

Was in need of a fast breakfast and this place has been on my list forever. Biscuit was pretty decent and so was the pastry (3.5 star quality). However the coffee was absolutely terrible, and they didn't have the oat milk they charged me for. The girl working the front was also a bit unpleasant.

Service was fantastic.   Never had to wait.  Drinks came well. 
Food is seasonal so be prepared for differences.  Drinks were well made of a bit uninspired.   Appetizer was roasted cauliflower and lobster Bisque.   Cauliflower a bit under cooked but flavorful.  Bisque was tasty after adding some salt and pepper.  Had the mahi salad and fillet mignon.   Both very well made. Dessert was the shot glass of strawberry cheesecake which tasted out of the box.  Recommend desserts are skipped.  
All in all a nice experience if a bit limited.
Ordered online at 6:40 and went to pick up my food, but the computers were down. Waited until 7:50 just for them to tell me they're only accepting cash. Ridiculous.

This was a cool place to check out. The atmosphere was really neat. Our dinners were good but not great. The mahi was pretty tasty but the portions are small. I had the jambalaya. It was pretty spicy. Definitely stop by the gift shop, they have some pretty fun things.

The food is great! It is as good as you could get in here, as far as authenticity goes. I would do something with the bathroom (there's only one) but asides, food's 9/10 (part because I haven't given out 10/10 yet and it's bit pricier. But you can't put a price on the authenticity haha)

This review is based on service at the bar. Though I have eaten here before and received full service, between that experience and my most recent, I'm choosing three stars as there is much room for improvement. While the atmosphere is upscale, and the menu interesting and diverse, service fell incredibly short. I met a friend for cocktails with the possibility of a third joining us. Our first round was served with no hiccups or delays. However, when our third arrived, the three of us sat with empty glasses and no greeting/acknowledgement whatsoever until we flagged down the female bartender that had been waiting on us. My guest ordered a glass of wine, I managed to hold the bartender's ear just long enough to get an order in for myself and when my last guest attempted to request his drink, the bartender had already zoomed off, ignoring him completely. Service remained this way for the rest of the evening while the bartender slammed bottles and mixing cups down on the bar in front of us. While it was incredibly busy that evening either she was 1-mad it was busy 2-not very tactful in how to mix drinks without slamming stuff around 3-not a good bartender for high pressure scenarios. At the end of our night she thanked us for our patience, however I had already decided that the next time I go out for craft cocktails it won't be here.
I love Brickies! Best burgers ever.  New owners adding a fryer is a plus.  I hope they bring in new stools.   I'm glad to hear the sports pools are staying.  Hope to be able to meet the new owners.

This is good flavorful reasonably priced food. Asian cuisine in all of its many varieties is my cuisine of choice with Thai being my absolute favorite. I've never had Loatia food prior to visiting Han Lao and was pleasantly surprised. Been here twice now and had the Khao Poon and crab Rangoon both times and both were delicious with the Khao Poon stealing the show. I wish they weren't closed for 2 hours because I pick my kid up from camp down the road at 4:30 and would really like to stop there a few days a week  on the way home but they don't reopen until 5 so we've had to skip a few times to visit a restaurant that was open.

Very cool, trendy hotel. Different than traditional chain hotels. Valet parking is the only parking options and is $45 a night; come and go as much as you please. 

A couple bars, to include a bar / alcohol bar in the lobby. Very unique decor to include cool furniture and fore place in the lobby. Two rooftop bars, one side with winter igloos and the other a walk up bar, small pool and a bus that has been widened, gutted and fitted with cool seating areas. Very much one of a kind. 

All staff members were extremely nice and friendly. Entire property was very clean. Wide hallways and oversized rooms. We got an end or corner room which had a little more room that the others. 
Room decor was very cool. Shower, no bath tub. Very comfy bed, wifi. Mimi fridge, and a safe all in the room. 

I totally forgot to take pictures here, but I highly recommend this place. Probably more so for adults, couples, or perhaps business travel. I would not recommend for a family hotel or miss in general.

Pros:

*Really tasty food - they allowed us to split the alligator bites app into 1/2 blackened and 1/2 fried
*The blackened catfish po-boy was great - the catfish was so soft and tender
*Server was very friendly

Cons:

*Ordered a dessert to share and only got one spoon. Took a while to flag down another server for another spoon. Damn tasty bread pudding though.
*Red beans and rice was meh. More like refried beans and rice with one literal stick of sausage sticking out. Cut it up for me! I'm an American damnit!! 
*Chain-like atmosphere
*Spent $76 on one app, two entrées, a tip and no cocktails. That's Bourbon Street for ya.

I came here to grab a local bite with family.

It's a cozy restaurant, not busy during dinner time.  Very fast service.  We ordered duck, birds nest, some other protein, some seafood stuff.  Its food , no complaints.

Definitely I found the food came out hot, the service ass fast, the lighting was good.

Dessert is self serve in pots near where you pay.  Today they served sweet pumpkin (like coconut milk base) and red bean.

Location takes credit card.

We are in town for a doctor appointment   Looking for a good meal without leaving the Hotel  GREAT Bbq
We are from Texas and we give it a big thumbs up
Prompt delivery   Thanks!

Had a wonderful time with Erich as our server tonight. Enjoyed the Maryhill, Riesling from Washington and the Crispy Calamari. Would recommend both. Some of their favorites are the Shepherds Pie and Fish n Chips. Come check this place out.
This is my first review ever. The Becky's Pasta and Pesto Bites are on point tonight. DELICIOUS! Love their pizza too.
Loved the food and the service!! The outside seating is wonderful looks like a beach oasis. Love it!

Love the vibe and atmosphere of this place! The music is always great and the bartenders are amazing! I also like  that you can choose the atmosphere you want. If you want a nice chill happy hour vibe right after work you can do that and if you want to party with a DJ all night you can do that too. I will definitely be back!

We really wanted to like it but it was just okay. Service was great! Definitely friendly and accommodating. The cake was nothing special, almost flavorless. The soft serve itself was good but it was too much!  Couldn't finish it. I guess if we go back we would share just one.

Came here for my first time with a friend for drinks and small bites, and was not disappointed! When you walk in the vibe and just fun and happy and exactly the type of place I'd want to drink. I was a little worried because the place seemed pretty crowded, but there are some communal tables that can always squeeze more. 

I ordered the sangria to drink and it tasted like a pink lemonade sangria. My plans to have one drink suddenly turned to two. My friend ordered a Spivey jalepeno margarita, not my thing, but she couldn't get enough of it. We ordered some chips and guacamole, which I'd say could use a little salt and pepper. At first it tasted pretty bland by had a kick of heat, and the chips aren't very salty, but the more I ate, the more it grew on me. 

I would definitely come back here again for happy hour and food!

We tried this restaurant for lunch and to satisfy our curiosity about Peruvian food. It did not disappoint! The food was wonderful and the service first rate. Our waitress recommended the two most authentic dishes which was helpful. Great place!

Cool and busy spot! The help gets you through the line quickly. This was our second visit. We picked up lemon cookies again. It's unfair how good the lemon cookies are. More time on the treadmill for me. We also decided on a chocolate covered white cream filled donut and a fritter. Both were very tasty. I also got a coffee. YUM!

Very typical diner that's stood the test of time. Located a bit oddly in a strip mall which has had a facelift so it is very easy to miss. Once you're inside, you are instantly transported back 50 years in time. Good variety of menu items and service is friendly and fairly fast. Easy on the wallet however no cards are accepted, although there's an ATM for convenience. Gotta say I wasn't crazy about the biscuits and gravy. That, they could possibly learn something from Cracker Barrel or Hardee's for that matter.

3rd time at Russell's. I was with a party of 8 on a Saturday evening at 7 pm. I would suggest making a reservation since Russell's is normally pretty busy, however, if you don't it's a nice old south city neighborhood to walk around in while you're waiting for a table. Service was great from the time we walked in until we left 2 hrs later. Food was outstanding and you can expect the unexpected with most of their dishes. The only drawback is that they run out of their famous desserts pretty fast so be sure to order as soon as possible.
My third visit, my third location. Absolutely in love with this place! I wish I didn't live 5 hours away. Can't stop thinking about the Carnitas.

Recently visited SRG and couldn't believe the quality of the food that I was presented. It was late afternoon...some chose options from the early bird menu...they didn't look all that great either....but, I went for the full price ($17.00) grouper sandwich. It was not hot, it was a lot smaller than the small bun it was on. It was fried but not crispy. The best thing on the plate was the lettuce and tomato. $16 Cosmo earlier and a $4 glass of house wine. A huge bill and terrible food. So disappointing! I will not being going back.
Amazing gluten free pizza. The sauce is sweeter than I am used to, not disappointing. When in Illinois I always seek Joe's out.

Good food and great margaritas! My favorite dish is the chicken and spinach enchiladas. The poblano sauce on them is so delicious. Also loved my frozen peach margarita. PS... you can get your margaritas to go ;)

Rode our bikes here from the Monon - pretty easy to get to! Nowhere to put our bikes, but we weren't worried about leaving them in the front yard. 

Lots of patio room which is great for sunny days! I was going to just get a brew, but we learned about Sour Saturdays, which 3 of the 4 of us got! A sour flight? Yes please! 

I love how many vegetarian options there were! If you aren't familiar with Seitan or other meat-less options, I recommend you try it, even if you do eat meat! 

For appetizers, I highly recommend the goat cheese or the spinach artichoke! It's served with some warm pita and chips. 

The staff is very friendly, engaging & has a great sense of humor. Great atmosphere for drinks with friends or dinner with family!

I got food to-go and nothing was as expected. The rice in the sushi was super mushy, the shrimp were soggy and the lobster Mac had huuuge, chewy piece of lobster that were hard to eat. But overall, the staff is always friendly. I'll try again another day

What a great sushi place, and just down the street. The Crab Rangoon is excellent! And there are an abundant number of choices for sushi itself. Order off the all you can eat menu, or stick to what you like (which we usually do), though we do try to add a new one on occasion. For fresh, flavorful and beautifully prepared sushi, Sushi Club is the place to go!

Honestly, I didn't eat or even go in, but the staff was accommodating in the midst of what could have been a crisis. Their security and  management were extremely helpful and I am grateful for their attempt at resolving a wrong. Unfortunately, they have some regular patrons that make this world a little uglier, too bad. Usually, when a place charges a cover and has a standard, the tide rises, but today it did not.

I was going to stay, grab some drinks and eat, but I was just bummed out by the experience of just driving in.

I can't wait to check it out, I am going to bring a posse of good to outnumber the shallow & evil. i want the opportunity to make this a 5.

We went her many years ago & had an amazing dinner & nice time.  The food was really great!  We got the filet & sea bass which were both amazing!  It seems that the atmosphere & clients really changed.  It was very noisy & disruptive.  You could not enjoy a quiet dinner conversation.  The waiter that we had was really nice but not attentive.  We had to wait to get refills, clear plates, take dessert orders...  For the price the service should be better & they did not seem busy to me at all.  A lot of empty tables.  The food is really great just need to make some changes with having more privacy & more intimate environment & more attentive wait staff.  I heard at least 3 tables around me complaining.

Wonderful people, amazing food! Very gracious and welcoming and happy to have patrons and we could tell that everyone was genuinely proud to work there and the service they provided. Best shrimp and grits ever, packed with flavor!!! Everything we ordered was good. Wine list goes through and explains each one so you know what you're ordering- fair prices for very good tasting wine.

I love the food here. The order size of fries compared to onion rings doesn't compare. You get very few onion rings but they are good. The hot dogs don't fit in that bread they use so it ends up very messy. I love the frozen custard. I recommend this restaurant and this location

We ate brunch at Ruby Sunshine and it was delicious. Our waiter was gramps as he told us to call him. He was great. When we asked for suggestions he was always ready to help!!  It was a wonderful experience

Hands down the best Thai food I have ever had. The Pad see ew with chicken is my go to but everything is so well prepared and flavorful. I always order mild because that Thai spice is no joke. Their curry is also one to try!! Delivery takes quite a while and pick up isn't any better but when you sit in, it doesn't seem to take as long. I have had ordered multiple things from here and haven't been disappointed. They are also the friendliest people. This is a MUST try and anyone I recommend to go says they love it!!

Roadhouse is one of the go tos for me. You know it will always come thru. 

Last night was no different. Started off by calling ahead and taking advantage of the call ahead seating. Jenaya always makes sure to explain how long we'll have to wait or not wait. We get there and are greeted by the team and wait only a little before Olivia takes us to our seat and makes sure to prep you for the adventure that's about to take place. 

We're seated with Dustin and immediately Im impressed with the service. Food and beverages are ordered and the night is Poppin. 

Food came, I got the sirloin smothered in blue  omg!!!! Melts in your mouth. Buddy ordered ribeye with mushrooms  looked amazing!!!! 

Andrew , a manager I think, is always walking the tables asking how everything is and if anything can be done to make things better.. as I stated , the Roadhouse will take care of you every step of the way!

We had a fabulous experience at Coterie NOLA. The Bloody Mary with house infused vodka was amazing and the char broiled oysters were the best we have ever had! Will definitely be coming back next time we are in town. Carl, Lawrence and Cory were so friendly and welcoming. Loved it!

Ok, I've been to many restaurants in the nation. New York, Boston, Austin, LA. NOTHING COMES CLOSE TO THIS. You go in there you order a beast plate with Mac & cheese and collard greens and you eat as much as you can. You don't have to eat it all just enough you wouldn't rip a hole in your intestinal lining and you start dying. But just after you stop eating you realize how much of a religious experience it is. You transcend your pitiful human senses and start to actually be something. It's probably the closest I'm legally going to get to drugs. Just trust me. If you go to this place expecting what you are going to expect from anywhere else then you will be disappointed, offended and injured. But if you think of it as a experience of a recepie passed down through generations, made by one family and one family only for decades, then you will love it. Not for children mind you, but you will L O V E I T

This place was really good the food was tasty and very well prepared. The manager gave us extra pita and baklava and was really nice when we came to pick up the food. I would recommend this place over the other Meditteranean places in SB.

Love my local Warrington Chick-til-A but they have major work to do such as getting their orders correct.  They do great with small order but large order you can count that something will go missing.  Double check folks!
Had lunch at this cute take joint. The food was fresh and fast. I had the bed tongue tacos and rice and beans, it was Delicious!!! This is a must try eatery

Beautiful restaurant in a lovely location. Love the decor! The food was fresh and very flavorful. Ive always experienced fantastic service at all of the Charro locations I have visited.. except for the past two experiences at Charro Vida. I visited two different times- the first time my friend and I sat at the bar and had an unenthusiastic bartender/server. We had to repeatedly ask for service which seemed to annoy her. She did not look like she enjoyed her job, I can't recall seeing one smile on her face, and it felt like we were an inconvenience sitting at the bar. We assumed she might be having a bad day and left it at that. The food and ambiance brought me back a second time. My friend suggested we sit at the bar.. I was hesitant given my last experience, but we headed that way. When we sat down, I saw the same bartender with the same look of dissatisfaction. I didn't even mention my previous experience to my friend and she immediately said, "She's not so friendly." We had to ask for service multiple times. When my friend received her soup, she nicely explained to bartender that it tasted bland. (which it did as I also tasted it) The bartender looked at it, didn't offer any solution, and walked away and continued what she was doing before we caught her attention. Eventually, my friend addressed her concern to another server who was bringing our entrees and she very graciously rectified the concern. We were thankful for her help! The rest of the time, it was a continuous s
The food is truly amazing! What a great wine selection, atmosphere and overall experience!!! Definitely the traditional dishes and the sauces are a win! Went for a special birthday celebration!

Great variety and tasting sushi and great owners and staff also! I'd only been able to go once since I always seem to miss them during their altered Covid hours but I haven't given up! Everything I ordered was fresh and delicious so I recommend this place to all!

My wife and I had been craving some cheesecake from The Cheesecake Factory so we figured we would have dinner beforehand (though cheesecake for dinner sounds totally acceptable to me!)  We got there just as dinner was starting and there was already a wait except on the patio so we opted for a table out there.  The patio was very comfortable and well insulated from the breeze that had been pretty strong that day.  We both ordered burgers which were delicious and cooked perfectly.  Fries were very good too.  Our server was very attentive.  We ordered our cheesecake to go and enjoyed it at home in bed, the perfect ending to a great meal!

Horrible service, ordered a carry out order, paid and everything, when we arrived to pick up the order, they said they never received it, but they sure did charge my card. Then the host has an attitude as if we never ordered, we show them the order number from the email received and the host still says hey did not receive it and that it was closing time so they were leaving, but still got charged, will never go back.

Friday 8.14.2020 9pm. My review is based on bar drinks & service, all excellent so I cannot comment on the food.  Social distancing, masks, sanitizer & table thoroughly wiped down by staff.  No sitting at the bar available due to Covid, but the high tops & tables in the bar are opened.  Our server was great!  Suggested an awesome cigar bar for us afterwards since they close at 10p.  Located in the Hilton, which is an excellent location to walk around downtown.

The team behind biscuit love had knocked it out of the park with their BRAND new wood-fired pizza spot in Hillsboro Village. Every single thing we ate was absolute perfection. Bonus: they also have the Italian beer Moretti on tap.

It's a tiny spot that features communal seating. All pizzas are served in to-go boxes where you can carry out or spend some time on their long picnic style seating.

We started with the Ricotta Dip with Honey and Wood-Fired Pizza Dough. This was absolutely delicious. We also got a side of their homemade pesto to dip the dough sticks in and it absolutely blew my mind. I plan on stopping in from time to time just to get gallons of this pesto to-go. 

We tried a variety of pizzas but hands down my personal favorite was THAT HIPSTER PLACE IN BROOKLYN ($14). This pie was red sauce and topped with sopressata, mozzarella and the condiment of 2019, HOT HONEY. Their hot honey is homemade and amazing. 

Another highlight was their dessert THE VINCENZO ($6). Tiramisu whip topped with caramel crunch. This was absolutely perfect after a carb heavy meal as it was actually super light yet packed with so much flavor.

Can NOT wait to be back to this amazing addition to Nashville!

excellent dishes, fresh & just like home!
Friendly service too, best Filipino dishes I've found so far in my many travels!

This restaurant is fulled with variety. Food is excellent and service is perfect. I enjoy both the Spicy Salmon Roll and Spicy Salmon Roll. All the fried rice dishes are great. This restaurant is also very clean. They care about their customers safety during the virus.

I ordered the brisket tacos and Ive literally never had a dryer brisket in my life.  It tasted like jerky.  The habenero pickled onions gave it some minute flavor.  My GF ordered the Brisket meal, somehow it was even more dry than mine!  She also had a side of mac n cheese which was literally out of a box of Kraft Mac n cheese and also dry!  Our waitress was great; very attentive.  Food was absolute trash.  Also the larger male bartender with glasses and a shaved end is rude and always has passive aggressive comments.  Not a fan.

TERRIBLE!!! I've ate at Hooters locations from Evansville,IN to Peoria,IL to New Orleans,LA to now Tampa. Haven't ate at a Hooters in Apx 10 years as I'm usually a BWW fan. I came to this Hooters tonight for dinner around 5:00p. I got fried pickles for an appetizer and 10 medium boneless wings. Fried pickles were ok, not great...just ok. Definitely much better at BWW. Now for the wings...they were terrible! Worst wings I've eaten in my entire life. I could have got a frozen bag of wings at Walmart and enjoyed much more. I attempted to eat them as I was hungry and didn't want to be rude and complain. When the waitress came to check on us before the bill she asked if we needed anything or a box for the wings as she saw I still had 1/2 the wings there. I told her no, I won't eat them. I said they were terrible and the worst wings I've ever eaten in my life. She was very nice...I didn't say it rude or disrespectful to her...just told her that I didn't like them at all. She went and told the manager in which they took the order off. That was nice but I left hungry and irritated. It was my birthday and I just wanted to have a good dinner and enjoy myself and it didn't happen. Not sure if I'll ever be back...if I do eventually go back another day...it won't be for quite awhile. The waitress was very nice and friendly so nothing against her...a sweet lady....but the food SUCKED!!!!
Service was fine however my order was missing items which I didn't find out until I got home. I called the location to be given attitude.... just a shame

I went for a fruity pebbles milk shake on opening day and was super excited to try it because I love the cereal. I was disappointed in the flavor. It did not have a strong fruit pebble taste and just tasted like a mango smoothie. I went back again for dinner and the burger was okay. The waiter told use the sriracha slaw was not that spicy so we ordered it. It was definitely a lot spicer than he claimed. The waiter stated after the fact that he puts hot sauce on everything so obviously it would not be spicy to him. I only took a few bites and threw the rest away. Don't think I would go to this place regularly. Maybe the chicken is better?
Not the worst in Boise.  Nor the best.    Good middle of the road burger.    They are a bit pricey for what you get.

We visited Scordato's pizza for the first time  and I loved it .  The host was nice and our server Patrick was extremely nice and attentive, pizza was delicious! Definitely my favorite pizza. Happy hour at 8pm to c made my night lol . I will be going back with my family and would be a good place for a girls night. Thank you for a great experience.
Great hole in the wall breakfast place. Menu is very basic and nothing too special but it's also very cheap so worth it. Great service and hosts and dogs are allowed to sit outside.
Stayed in the hotel across the street. First time to the restaurant. I had a steak kebab. It was made to order and had great seasoning.
Pizza was delivered a lil on cold side but very tasty... I would order again no hesitation
this place is so amazing!!! The lamb burger is the best! They have a really good happy  hour & not to mention the feel good burger changes monthly, and some proceeds go to charities! Awesome!

I went out for drinks and appetizers with my SIL. She wanted to get a good cocktail so we decided to try this place out. She ordered two different cocktails both of which she said were great! I ordered two glasses of Savignon Blanc. 

For appetizers we started with the Buffalo Chicken Cheesesteak "Pretzel" which resembled more of Stromboli. It was served with a side of ranch sauce and a side of hot sauce. The inside of the Stromboli was a chicken cheesesteak meat with lots of cheese. This app was good but not really what it described on the menu with calling it a pretzel. 

We also ordered the Hummus plate which was HUGE! We didn't finish it and there was two of us. It definitely is a nice platter for 4 people. 

Another app that we ordered was the Brussels sprouts. They came deep fried with bacon, fried onions and caramelized maple syrup. They were delicious!! I definitely recommend these to anyone who comes here! 

And for dessert we ordered the warm chocolate chip cookie skillet with vanilla ice cream. This skillet came out super hot! The skillet itself was on the smaller side and serving size I would say is between 1-2 people. There was two small scoops of vanilla ice cream on top. I would definitely order this again!
I had the Ragin Cajun and it might have been the best sandwich I've ever had. Also, got the fried with Cajun season and it was no disappointment. 10/10 would recommend
I'm not sure why this place doesn't have great reviews!! This place is awesome! The atmosphere is cute- good service- not busy AT ALL !! And AWESOMEEEE sushi!! I recommend the dragon roll OMG!

The salmon here is to die for.

I was meeting my boss at Embarc and realized that Cass Street Deli was pretty close by. Melony R. gave me a gift card for my birthday, but I hadn't made it down here yet, because I don't drive far for food that often since having a baby (yes, that was a year and a half ago, but I will use him as an excuse every chance I get). 

I looked on Yelp to find out the parking sitch and saw that there is a private lot. Ok, that's true but generous. I think there are like a total of two spots. However, this is not a popular part of town so I bet there is a ton of street parking. 

The salmon salad isn't on the menu, but it was available today. I love how they advertise that you should sample their salads. I didn't partake, but I appreciate that option. I got the full size salmon salad on challah and took it to go.

These are pricier sandwiches for normal portion sizes. I wouldn't have been full with only a half. But they are high quality and delicious. The salmon was so tender. I wish it had a little less dressing to let the salmon shine through, but overall it was fantastic. I had the same qualm about the challah. It was so amazing on its own that it didn't need the butter, I would have actually preferred it without. 

Those are two very small cons that are overweighed by the amount of love I have for this sandwich. My husband says you can tell when I enjoy something because I nod while eating it. I was totally headbanging to this sandwich.

I can't wai

During Covid.. my choice of where to eat is limited, because I try to eat at restaurants with outside seating.  Ella's has a great outdoor space under the shade of trees!  Plus, you can bring your dog!  My experience was wonderful.  I started with the watermelon mimosa and wow.. was it good!  Nice and refreshing with a strong watermelon flavor.. which I love.  For my meal I ordered the veggie burger and the waitress said I could have the fried green tomatoes as my side.  Yes please!  They were excellent.. not greasy.. flavorful and a lovely dipping sauce.  Sometimes when you get a homemade veggie burger it falls apart and you end up eating just the bun in your bite.  Not at Ella's!  It was one of the best veggie burgers I've ever had while dining out.  My mom is a vegetarian and I want to take her here so she can enjoy one and bring along her adorable pooch.  I'm looking forward to going back.

I have seen several complaints about the food I just had a fresh hot cheeseburger and fries and a awsome bartender  named Ashley  ...i dont live here but I'll be back I'll promise you that .. I'm SW Detroit born and will support a fellow  michigander  all day every day
Our waiter was patient, experienced and attentive. The octopus was amazing! Loved the atmosphere. Will be back.

Wanted to send some #yelplove to Blue Oak BBQ for our weekly quarantine takeout! We ordered some two meat platters with chopped brisket, ribs, wings, sausage, Mac and cheese, baked beans, slaw, and potato salad. The baked beans were some of the best I've ever had and the Mac is the best I've had so far in NOLA. The meat was all great! The ribs fell right off the bone and the wings were amazing! We also got some banana pudding to top it all off and it was so good! The takeout process was so seamless and I appreciate the measures they're taking to keep their customers and employees safe. Can't wait to come back and sit on their patio when life returns to normal!

The absolute Best Fried Chicken in the Montgomery County area. Not greasy, super crispy skin. Priced just right. Mac and cheese is good too. This is a new find for us and will be the ONLY place I order from.

Our friends insisted that we have breakfast here on our last day in town & I'm so glad that they did. We were lucky enough to be served by Matt who was on his last day in training. Great full is so lucky to have him! What a sweet kind person who handled our numerous dietary restrictions with so much care and caution. I wish we had come here on day one so I could have tried more of their delicious dishes! Will stop in next time we're in town. Thanks again

They have the BEST chicken tacos and their burritos are great too. The owner and workers are incredibly nice, and the service is always quick. This is probably my favorite places in West Philly for quick food. Definitely recommend!!

Visited Sugar Factory during its opening week and was impressed. The ambiance at the space was fun and bright! There are neon signs, floral decor and smoke filled drinks all around. The staff puts on a performance and dance to certain songs ever so often, it's a spectacle that all guests enjoy. The drinks are oversized, tasty and strong - just the way I like them. As for food I had the veggie burger and I considered it to be overpriced. Sugar Factory is certainly a space for a good entertaining evening.

For the price and location I was very disappointed. Service was just okay. The redfish was overwhelmed by their sauce which was not tasty. My guests had the chicken. Sandwich which was very dry.  I would definitely not come back

Asia Gourmet is possibly the finest Asian in St. Louis. It's consistent and double delicious. 
The General Tso chicken is crispy, won ton soup is unusually velvety.   Their food is not your standard fare,  the chef spins classics.
Food is $$, but it's 2 meals, portions generous. 
Don't let the hole in the wall appearance fool you like it did me.  Just discovered this downtown jewel after driving by it for over 6 years.

I found this place from google reviews and thought by the pictures that it would be very good. When we walked in, it was 8:25pm and I was immediately told that they were closing soon. I said, " well it's over a half hour away still " and proceeded to order. Given I haven't been here before, I asked what the best, most popular pizza was and the gal said she didn't know. So I ordered the wild garlic and the wild Hawaiian. The food was OK at best! What was most concerning was the lack of attention and the lack of care from staff. Out pizza came quick but we were not given or offered utensils, ranch, Parmesan or drinks. I had to get up and ask and while standing at the bus station looking into the kitchen at the gal sitting against equipment on her phone, I literally had to ask over and over " EXCUSE ME!!" And never got a response from her. Finally another gal said she would help me. While eating, the phone rang multiple times and the staff ignored it, Walked up to the phone and looked at it and walked away. NO ANSWER! so I see that this place should be doing well, however it is clear from the lack of care from the staff, why this place is dead and not very good.

We have been wanting to try City Park Grill for a couple of years.  I wish we didn't wait so long.  What a friendly place, great food and drinks.  We will definitely be back many times.  I can't wait until the weather is good and the patio is open.  I didn't even know they had a patio!  The restaurant is very spacious so no worries about social distancing.  If you haven't, try it!

I'll never eat here again. The staff seemed nice but pressure washing floors during business hours IN THE KITCHEN while preparing food is unacceptable. And wouldn't kill them to take out the trash as opposed to it overflowing while bagging the food. I never want to see anyone lose there job but the cleaning protocol for the kitchen needs to be changed to AFTER hours! Mind you they do not have indoor dining either so this mess is all them! If it wasn't for my pregnant wife at home craving it t I would have turned right around. Disappointing all around.

We decided to give this place a shot for carryout on a Sunday morning.  We placed the order, and it was ready for pickup right at the expected time.  The restaurant seemed clean, but I didn't have much time to assess this.  I was in and out quickly, with the food neatly packed up for us.    

My wife got the veggie skillet and I got the southern skillet, and we also ordered some of the fried mush (polenta) to share.  Everything was nice and hot, even when we got home.  The eggs were done correctly per the order.  Both skillet dishes were tasty... decent size portions, too.  The fried mush was a nice accompaniment as well.

We will have to give dine-in a try when we can.  The food was good, so we are interested in trying out more of the menu!

We happened to drive by and we're hungry. Stopped in ordered the vegan VLT. Hands down best sandwich Ever! I cannot say enough about how much I enjoyed this sandwich. My daughter is NOT vegan and absolutely loved it too!! 
5 stars is not enough!

Ordered to go, took 25 mins for a salad, did not bring out to car. Had to wait for host or anyone to acknowledge me when I walked in. Forgot extra breadsticks I asked for. Not sure how this place is still in business.
I don't know why I tried this place again.  For the second time, I was refused service.   This really is the worst McDonalds.   Not worth the stop.

Horrible gumbo! 
The gumbo was awful and taste burnt and the crab cake was worst I won't be returning!!!!!
Outdoor patio was beautiful though and waiters and hosts were very kind!

We just had a wonderful time at Cajun Steamer. The food was great, but the best part was our server Portia. She was upbeat and knowledgeable about all the food. 
Etouffee, red beans, jambalaya, crawfish, fresh oysters, and peel and eat shrimp were delicious.

Stopped in this place for a Happy Meal on 05/16/2019. 

I can't believe this is an actual McDonald's! At first I thought that it must be a knock off one like the one in that movie, "Coming to America" w Eddie Murphy from way back. "McDowell's" or something like that it was called in the movie. At least the one in the movie was clean. This one, it's absolutely the worst one that I've ever been in or even heard about!! Exceptionally dirty! Were those bug zappers on the walls? It's attached to a filthy,  blown out BP gas station. I. Just. Couldn't. Believe. This. Place. 

McDonald's Corporate, what do they have on y'all that you can't shut these guys down? Seriously, it truly shocks me that the City Health Department hasn't closed this place down. During the 20 minutes that we waited for our food we looked and looked for a Food Safety Rating but couldn't find one. 

Stay. The. Heck. Away.

So this is new to me being that my sister introduced me to this place. All staff were wearing mask along with ourselves. Feels good to step out of the comfort zone with COVId going on, however didn't stay long. Lol. Our waitress was Tabby. We received our menus and went off of the suggestions of the waitress. Ordered two Hurricanes, PoBoy Sandwiches, Jambalaya rice cup and Sweet Potatoes Fries. Theo place got a 4 star due to the Dirty Utensils. Manager came over and asked how was everything going and we informed him of the utensils. Very nice guy and apologize for it. Good spot and will definitely come back!

This is the place to order from. I had the cheesesteak and cheesesteak hoagie! Great sandwich. I broke down and ate bread too. I am on a Leto diet but it was good! Been back frequently as I work in the pharmaceutical quality field and have to work. Staff is incredible!!

I can't even begin to say how amazing this place is! From the customer service from Joyce to the amazing food! I had never tried vietnamese food and I had alot of questions and Joyce answered them all with excitement,  which made me want to try everything! We had the seafood pho and bang bang shrimp and the ribeye sandwich...... I couldn't tell you which i loved more.....this place is amazing, we will be back again and again.....

Originally we had planned to go to a different sushi place but they were packed, this place was close by so we decided go here instead. There was no wait at all and the service was quick. The rolls here are so good and we will DEFINITELY be coming back here!
Nothing special about the food here. The service is good but the food is just okay. The floor was pretty stick which means dirty so it's not the cleanest place.

The food at this location tends to be better than any of the others in the area. The service is always pleasant and attentive. My issue is that, on our last visit a week ago, there was no distancing tables. Other patrons were sitting at the booths in front, behind us, and adjacent to us. I found this to be particularly disappointing.

Checked into the Sands for a much needed get-away, and got our players cards. They had a promotion to get 50 points on your first day and you get a free buffet. We played a little video blackjack and got our free buffets! There was no line on Sunday night and we were quickly seated. Manuel was our server, and he could not have been more attentive, or have been any better. He was fantastic. Very professional, constantly refilling our drinks, we also choose coffee and he brought us our own carafe. He really felt like he should be in a 5 Star restaurant. 
There were many choices on the buffet, lots of peel and eat shrimp, and choices for vegetarians as well. The fried shrimp were not certainly l crispy like they should be. Prime rib was very good, very tender. Lots of desserts to choose from, but most were cafeteria quality. The creme brulee was brutal. But the coconut passion fruit cheese cake was pretty good. Lots of sugar free choices for those desiring that. 
All in all, it was a nice dinner, Manuel, making it even better! Give him a raise!!

Pre-COVID-19 we flew in for a long weekend and had such an amazing dinner! Everything was done beautifully without arrogance. My friend has an extremely refined palate and she was still impressed. Both alcoholic and nonalcoholic cocktails were innovative and fresh as well. Even though we were there for only 3 days, we absolutely had to have a second meal while still in town, and were incredibly lucky to have met Chef Brock when we returned for lunch! I want to fly back just to have his amazing food!

Stopped by this cafe while visiting a friend who lives in the area. There was a short 15 minute wait for a table and we were seated accordingly. I ordered the cinnamon raisin french toast with a side of home fries. I enjoyed my meal. The french toast was a little dry but overall tasty and the potatoes were yummy. We were being served by 2 different waitresses so it was a little confusing but the service was quick. If i'm in the area again, i'd come back here!

Omg the coco feine (with oat milk)!! Just do it  perfect little spot. Can't wait to come back after COVID restrictions die down but they are doing a great job keeping the line moving and people caffeinated. Friend got a pumpkin latte and she loved it!

Was looking for something late-night while out and happened to see Jim's Steaks is open very late on Friday nights. It was pretty quiet, but the staff was Super-friendly and asked about everything for my order as they went.
     I had a cheese steak with fried onions, provolone cheese, and a little ketchup, plus a side of fries. Steak slices are big, and while you get a good size portion, it's not overstuffed like some places (where you can't get a good bite of all the ingredients.) Onions are mixed in. Since I had a bit of a drive home, it stayed pretty warm after 40 minutes. The mix of onions, beef, and ketchup reminded me of a White Castle burger, in a good way. Fried were fresh and probably would have been perfect if I ate them on the spot. Even by the time I was home they were still tasty.
     Pretty good overall steak!
Best Southwest Salad I've ever tasted. Southwest Chicken Salad. Awesome customer service as well. Keep up the great work.
Out of this world! Amazing!  Great service - great food - the drinks were off the hook!

My friends turned me on to Ale Emporium because it is a great sports bar with TV's all throughout the restaurant and a fantastic craft beer list.  The Hermaki chicken wings are some of the best chicken wings I have had in Indy.    The dry rub on the chicken wings is fantastic and the spices really come out in the taste when you bite into one of their chicken wings.  All of their food items are terrific, so no matter what you order off of the menu, it is going to be good.  I was very impressed with the Covid-19 guidelines Ale emporium has put into place.   They had outdoor seating during the summer and fall in front of the restaurant and social distancing seating inside the restaurant.   The curbside pickup is also a big hit for carry out orders.  They have done a wonderful job keeping customers safe and enjoying the dining experience.   The service is wonderful every time I come to Ale Emporium.  I will always come to Ale Emporium for excellent wings and beer because I know I will get my money's worth!

Just to get it out front..the hostess, Cheyenne was an arrogant, rude, nasty individual- who was overheard speaking not so pleasantly about myself and my guests..to the point my girlfriend got up and asked her to stop. This alone has me doubting if I will return. 

With that said, Sam our server and the young man that helped him were excellent. The appetizers were decent- mushrooms and oysters.. the bread was excellent.. I chose the soup of the day, chowder, and it was excellent..not your traditional cup of creamy goo..the steaks, for the price, were not what I would expect but still filling.  Plan on an expensive evening, dinner for four, and desert, tip...$400 plus...
